notes: Read all 196 numbered source lines before editing. Header docstring L5-7/L64-79 (purpose: single-select filter row for trend switchers + list collections; WAI-ARIA Tabs pattern; does not own panels) is preserved in the native file header + the component JSDoc.

Imports L1-3: useId/useRef/KeyboardEvent are DOM-only (roving-tabindex focus + key events) and dropped; type ReactNode L1 is kept for the icon prop; cn L2 (Tailwind class merge) has no native analogue — class logic becomes StyleSheet arrays; fmtInt L3 from @/lib/numberFormat is inlined faithfully (locale separators, 0 decimals, nullish/NaN->0, default en-US locale matching web _globalLocale). No DOM/web-UI module is imported.

PillItem interface L8-24 ported one-for-one: key L10, label L12, icon?:ReactNode L14, count?:number L16, accent union 'cyan'|'green'|'amber'|'red'|'purple'|'blue' L21, disabled? L23 (comment adjusted from 'arrow navigation' to 'selection' since keyboard nav is DOM-only).

PillFilterBarProps L26-44 preserved: items readonly PillItem[] L27, activeKey L28, onChange L29, ariaLabel L31, variant 'pills'|'tabs' L37, scrollable L39; the web className L41 -> native style:StyleProp<ViewStyle> on the tablist row, testId L43 -> testID. PillAccent type alias added for the StyleSheet accent maps.

ACCENT_PILL map L46-53 (Tailwind bg-500/15 + text-300 + ring-400/40 + dot-400) -> resolved native pillAccentStyles (active bg+border) + pillDotStyles (dot bg) + pillTextStyles (selected text), reusing theme tokens (cyan->accentSoft/borderAccent/accent, green->success*, amber->warning*, red->danger*, purple->violet*, blue->rgba(99,102,241,.16)/rgba(129,140,248,.4)/#818cf8) — same mapping proven in charts/MetricSwitcherChart.

ACCENT_TAB map L55-62 (border-400 + text-300) -> tabBorderStyles (selected borderBottomColor per accent, 400 shade) + reused pillTextStyles for the 300-shade selected text; the underline replaces the web border-b-2.

Component signature + defaults L80-89 preserved (variant='pills' L85, scrollable=true L86). useId L90 (tab ids) and the refs Map L91 (HTMLButtonElement focus targets) are DOM-only and omitted — native Pressable has no id/imperative focus; documented in the header.

enabledKeys L93, moveFocus L95-100 (onChange + requestAnimationFrame focus), handleKeyDown L102-118 (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight wrap, Home, End, preventDefault) implement the roving-tabindex keyboard model, which has no touch-native analogue; intentionally omitted. The single-select behaviour they drove is fully preserved: press -> onChange, aria-selected/tabIndex -> accessibilityState selected, disabled -> accessibilityState disabled + Pressable disabled.

Outer div role=tablist L120-131 -> View accessibilityRole='tablist' + accessibilityLabel=ariaLabel (L123) + testID (data-testid L124); className flex items-center gap-1.5 L126 -> styles.row (row, alignItems center, gap 6); scrollable overflow-x-auto L127 -> horizontal ScrollView wrapper (showsHorizontalScrollIndicator=false); variant tabs border-b L128 -> styles.rowTabs (borderBottom 1, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); className L129 -> style prop merged last.

items.map L132-134: selected = activeKey===item.key L133, accent = item.accent ?? 'cyan' L134 ported verbatim. baseClass branch L136-153 (pills rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs vs tabs px-3 py-2 text-sm border-b-2, focus-visible ring, selected accent, disabled opacity-40) -> styles.pill / styles.tab + selected pillAccentStyles|[tabSelected,tabBorderStyles] + styles.disabled(opacity .4); focus-visible ring is DOM-only and replaced by the pressed-opacity feedback (styles.pressed).

button L155-171 -> Pressable: key L157; id L158 + ref L159-162 dropped (DOM focus plumbing); type=button L163 -> accessibilityRole='tab' (L164); aria-selected L165 + tabIndex L166 -> accessibilityState selected; disabled L167 -> disabled prop + accessibilityState disabled; onClick L168 -> onPress(()=>onChange(item.key)); onKeyDown L169 omitted (keyboard nav); className L170 -> the style({pressed}) array; a per-item testID is added for native test hooks.

Leading dot L172-174 (pills + selected, h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ACCENT_PILL.dot, aria-hidden) -> styles.pillDot(6x6 r3)+pillDotStyles[accent], rendered only when !isTabs && selected, hidden from a11y (accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility no-hide-descendants + pointerEvents none).

Icon wrapper L175-179 (aria-hidden span sizing svg 3.5) -> styles.icon centered View, a11y-hidden; icon?:ReactNode rendered verbatim (web [&>svg] CSS sizing has no native equivalent — caller sizes the node, documented).

Label span L180 -> AppText numberOfLines=1 weight semibold, base muted (pillLabel / tabLabel fontSize 14 for tabs text-sm) + selected pillTextStyles[accent]. Count suffix L181-190 (typeof count==='number'; ml-0.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums; selected opacity-80 else opacity-60; ({fmtInt(count)})) -> AppText styles.count(10px, marginLeft 2, fontVariant tabular-nums) + countSelected/countIdle opacity + selected accent colour; '(' + fmtInt(item.count) + ')' preserved.

Closing JSX L191-196 (button, map, div, return, fn close) ported; scrollable wraps the tablist content View in a horizontal ScrollView, non-scrollable returns it directly. Default export added for ergonomic native imports (matches DatePresetChips).
